title: 1 Chronicles 2–8 Exhaustive Sub-Clans (Jarha the Egyptian, Bithiah dau. of Pharaoh, Simeon, Reuben, Gad, Benjamin, Asher) & Geoffrey Keating's Complete Irish Gaelic Genealogies

nodes.name: Jerahmeel ben Hezron (+ Atarah) → Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, Ahijah & Onam (1 Chr 2:25–33)
nodes.role: Firstborn Clan of Hezron of Judah
nodes.notes: Hezron's firstborn Jerahmeel wed a second wife Atarah, mother of Onam (-> Shammai, Jada -> Peleth & Zaza); elder line via Ram -> Maaz, Jamin & Eker.

nodes.name: Sheshan → Daughter Ahlai + Jarha the Egyptian → Attai → Nathan → Zabad → Elishama (1 Chr 2:34–41)
nodes.role: Explicit 13-Generation Egyptian Bloodline Grafted Into Tribe of Judah!
sources: Jacob M. Myers Anchor Bible 1 Chronicles (1965)
nodes.notes: Sheshan of Jerahmeel had no sons, so he gave his daughter Ahlai to his Egyptian servant Jarha — establishing a 13-generation documented Egyptian-Judahite pedigree: Jarha + Ahlai -> Attai -> Nathan -> Zabad -> Ephlal -> Obed -> Jehu -> Azariah -> Helez -> Eleasah -> Sismai -> Shallum -> Jekamiah -> Elishama!

nodes.name: Ashhur Father of Tekoa (+ Helah & Naarah) → Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, Haahashtari & Zohar (1 Chr 4:5–7)
nodes.role: Founder of Judahite Tekoa (Home of Prophet Amos)
nodes.notes: Posthumous son of Hezron & Abijah; wed Helah and Naarah, founding Tekoa and Bethlehem-area clans.

nodes.name: Jabez ('More Honorable Than His Brothers', 1 Chr 4:9–10)
nodes.role: Judahite Patriarch of Scribal Clans of Jabez
nodes.notes: Famed in 1 Chronicles 4 for his prayer of blessing and associated in 1 Chr 2:55 with the Kenite scribal families (Rechabites -> Hammath).

nodes.name: Mered of Judah + Bithiah Daughter of Pharaoh (1 Chr 4:18) → Miriam, Shammai & Ishbah
nodes.role: Second Explicit Egyptian Royal Princess Wed Into Judahite Line!
nodes.notes: Beside Caleb's line in 1 Chr 4:17–18, Mered married BOTH a Jewish wife (Jered, Heber, Jekuthiel) AND 'Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh' — bearing Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah (rabbinic tradition identifies Mered with Caleb and Bithiah with Moses's adoptive mother!).

nodes.name: Shobal (Father of Kiriath-jearim) & Salma (Father of Bethlehem) — Sons of Hur (1 Chr 2:50–55)
nodes.notes: Sons of Hur (firstborn of Ephrath & Caleb) who settled Bethlehem, Kiriath-jearim, Zorathites & Kenite scribes.

nodes.name: Simeonites (1 Chr 4:24–43): Shallum → Mibsam → Mishma → Hammuel → Zaccur → Shimei (16 Sons & 6 Daughters)
nodes.role: Simeonite Desert Princes & Mt. Seir Settlers
nodes.notes: Details Simeon's southern clans including Shimei's 16 sons and 6 daughters and 500 Simeonites under Ishi's sons (Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, Uzziel) who settled Mt. Seir.

nodes.name: Reubenites (1 Chr 5:4–6): Joel → Shemaiah → Gog → Shimei → Micah → Reaiah → Baal → Prince Beerah
nodes.role: Transjordanian House of Reuben Until Tiglath-Pileser III
nodes.notes: Complete 8-generation Reubenite lineage ending with tribal prince Beerah, carried captive to Halah and Habor by Assyrian emperor Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul).

nodes.name: Gadites in Bashan (1 Chr 5:11–17): Joel, Shapham, Janai, Shaphat & Abihail ben Huri
nodes.notes: Traces Gadite houses in Gilead and Bashan registered under Kings Jotham of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel.

nodes.name: Half-Tribe of Manasseh in Bashan & Mt. Hermon (1 Chr 5:24): Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah & Jahdiel
nodes.notes: Seven named tribal heads of eastern Manasseh from Bashan to Mount Hermon.

nodes.name: Issachar (1 Chr 7:1–5): Tola → Uzzi → Izrahiah → Michael, Obadiah, Joel & Isshiah
nodes.notes: Traces Tola's six warrior clans (Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, Shemuel) and Izrahiah's five chief sons.

nodes.name: Benjamin (1 Chr 7:6–12, 8:1–32): Jediael, Shaharaim (+ Hushim & Baara/Hodesh in Moab), Beriah & Shema (Aijalon)
nodes.role: Complete Benjamite Houses of Geba, Moab, Aijalon & Jerusalem
nodes.notes: Includes Shaharaim (who fathered seven sons by Hodesh and Hushim in the country of Moab), Beriah & Shema (founders of Ono, Lod & Aijalon), and Jeiel's Gibeon clan.

nodes.name: Asher (1 Chr 7:30–40): Heber → Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham & Sister Shua (F) → Zophah & Ithran
nodes.role: Northern Coastal Asherite Pedigree & Named Daughter Shua
nodes.notes: Complete 4-generation pedigree from Heber ben Beriah ben Asher down through Birzaith, Shomer, Hotham, and named sister Shua (1 Chr 7:32).

nodes.name: O'Brien / Dal gCais Pedigree (Keating pp.2–10): Cormac Cas → Brian Boru → Turlough → Muirchertach → Donnchadh Cairbreach
nodes.role: Munster / Thomond High-King Pedigree From Eber Finn
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf)
nodes.notes: Complete unbroken generational stem of the Dal gCais (O'Briens, O'Carrolls, McMahons & MacNamaras) from Milesius's son Eber Finn -> Oilioll Olum -> Cormac Cas -> Cass -> Brian Boru -> Turlough -> Conor na Siudaine.

nodes.name: Eoghanacht of Cashel & Desmond (Keating): Eoghan Mor → Fiacha Muilleathan → Corc → Ceallachan of Cashel → MacCarthy Mor & O'Sullivan
nodes.role: Royal Eoghanacht Kings of Cashel & Munster
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf pp.3–9)
nodes.notes: Traces the elder Milesian line of Eber Finn through Eoghan Mor -> Fiacha Muilleathan -> Corc of Cashel -> Nad Fraoich -> Ceallachan Caisil -> Carthach (eponym of MacCarthy Mor) & O'Sullivan Beara.

nodes.name: Northern Ui Neill (Keating): Eoghan (O'Neill of Tyrone) & Conall Gulban (O'Donnell of Tyrconnell & St. Columba of Iona!)
nodes.role: Most Famous Northern Irish Royal & Monastic Bloodline From Niall
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf)
nodes.notes: Two eldest sons of Niall of the Nine Hostages: Eoghan -> Cenel nEoghain -> Hugh O'Neill (Earl of Tyrone); Conall Gulban -> Fedlimid -> St. Columba (Colum Cille, Apostle of Scotland!) & Red Hugh O'Donnell.

nodes.name: O'Connor Kings of Connacht (Keating): Eochaid Mugmedon → Brion → Turlough Mor → Rory O'Connor (Last High King of Ireland, d. 1198)
nodes.role: Western High Kings of Ireland (Ui Briuin)
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf)
nodes.notes: Half-brother of Niall of the Nine Hostages -> Brión -> Ui Briuin -> Turlough Mor -> Rory O'Connor (Ruaidri Ua Conchobair, last High King of Ireland before the Anglo-Norman arrival).

nodes.name: Kings of Leinster (Keating): Cathaoir Mor → Diarmait Mac Murchada → Princess Aoife (+ Strongbow → Isabel de Clare!)
nodes.role: Milesian Eremon Line Bridging Into Anglo-Norman & British Royalty!
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf)
nodes.notes: Traces Eremon -> Ugaine Mor -> Cathaoir Mor -> Diarmait Mac Murchada, whose daughter Aoife MacMurrough wed Richard de Clare ('Strongbow') -> Isabel de Clare (+ William Marshal!) — directly injecting ancient Milesian/Gaelic royal blood into English, Scottish & European royalty!

nodes.name: Dal Riada & Ulster/Pictish Clans (Keating): Cairbre Riada → Fergus Mor mac Erc; plus Ir (Magennis/O'More) & Ith (O'Driscoll)
nodes.role: Irish-Scottish Dal Riada Link & Lines of Ir and Ith
sources: Geoffrey Keating Foras Feasa ar Eirinn Genealogies (4. Geneal_Synch.pdf)
nodes.notes: Completes the four Milesian stems in Keating: Eremon's Dal Riada branch crossing to Argyll/Scotland under Fergus Mor, plus Ir (Magennis, O'More, Conall Cearnach) and Ith (O'Driscoll).
